column1: # DISPOSITION OF FORM-DECIDING SITES WITHOUT A LITERAL KEY
# Covers every inventory row whose key cell means any key. A row is named-keys when a finite set of configuration paths anchors it; exclusion means no named path applies.

# A fifth-set candidate exists only where RuleOptionsInterface declarations are the relevant declaration side. Framework-owned keys are marked separately because acceptedOptionKeys() does not own them.
# Columns: file, line, class, method, resolution, keys, reason, fifth_set_candidate, snippet_check.
# Bounded replacement: obsolete physical addresses are retired; current document/schema, typed composition and owner-consumer anchors are recorded separately.
# Unchanged live-file records retain their original survey; this update does not claim a complete fresh census of those addresses.
